ns2:section.sectionText: Journalism Movies. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. This course will examine a particular genre of film, the journalism movie. Students will study the movies in their cultural and historical contexts, participate in classroom discussions, do assigned readings and write papers addressing the moviesø depictions of the press. The courseøs primary focus is journalism, although it will discuss some aspects of film history and theory.
